name: moroccan-darija-captions
description: Review and align Moroccan Darija and mixed Arabic, French, and English captions, then build an editable vertical video in HyperFrames or Remotion.

interface.longDescription: Choose your assistant, current transcription model, and video editor. Preserve Darija in Arabic script, review word timings, and render mixed-script captions with HyperFrames or Remotion.
defaultPrompt: Use Moroccan Darija Captions. Identify the assistant ecosystem from the active environment and do not ask me to repeat it. Before asking preferences, perform a scoped read-only inventory of available local transcription/alignment models, relevant provider credential availability, and editor/render tools without revealing secret values. Then show the findings and ask once for any missing speech route, alignment fallback, audio-upload and cost consent, named package/model install consent, project destination, and full-task checks/build/preview/render authorization. Skip answers already in my request or project, then complete the authorized video task without repeating those approvals.
